products.tagline_zh: Ship on both stores from one project using Swift + Kotlin
products.description_zh: Modaal for Android let you ship one app to both stores with your own AI agent - no rebuild. So anyone who built an iPhone app with Modaal can add Android without touching a line of logic — no credit meters, no rebuild.
